text:
sam-recruiter: FYI 00% verbal accept from Asha (senior infra engineer). Offer ready but we need a band exception + sign-on gross-up request. Candidate relocating from India -> US (starts on H1B).

nina-peopleops: Why gross-up? do we have a tax memo?

sam-recruiter: Hiring manager requested gross-up because of expected withholding during relocation month + escrow timing overseas. Proposed comp: total cash $260k (base 160k / target 60k / sign-on 40k). Request: elevate to band E5 (company comp policy says E4 cap breaks parity). Sign-on proposed 60% now / 40% on 6mo review, with gross-up for the first tranche to cover withholding. Start date target 2026-06-01 but visa might force a 2-4 week shift.

marta-hm: Confirming manager sign-off. This hire is backfill+expansion; earlier start helpful. We can accept a short start flexibility window.

ana-legal: tagging @ana-legal (typo) - Ana here. We need local tax counsel on gross-up implications and immigration team input re: when payroll can start. Also, equity vesting alignment: if start delayed >30 days, do we pro-rate grant effective date? Please include requested grant date and vesting alignment in submission.

leo-finance: Finance needs cashflow schedule and GL codes. Are we doing payroll in USD or INR for the first partial month? Also need to know if the sign-on is onshore or paid to the overseas bank account.

sam-recruiter: Cashflow calc in attached sheet: `gdrive.com/asha-cashflow`. Proposed payroll USD from first US payroll cycle. Sign-on to be paid to candidate's US account after transfer; first tranche grossed-up amount estimated at $26k (net target 24k). GL: ENG-OPS-11.

offer-bot: Approval request REQ-2026-0620-12 created. Approvers: nina-peopleops, joel-comp (chair), leo-finance, ana-legal, hr-immigration. Status: Pending-comp-committee. Link: https://rbwd/approvals/REQ-2026-0620-12

joel-comp: We have a comp-committee meeting tomorrow at 09:30 PT. If this is urgent, please add "expedite" flag in the request. Provide market comps (3 peers) and internal parity.

sam-recruiter: Added market comps + SG compensation note to the packet. Marked expedite. Also included candidate's competing offer (confidential).

nina-peopleops: Good. Two quick asks: (1) Include immigration ETA note so legal + immigration can give a payroll start estimate; (2) confirm whether the sign-on gross-up will be permanent policy exception or one-off.

sam-recruiter: Immigration ETA: DS-201/visa transfer expected by late May (best-case). Gross-up: manager requests one-off exception.

ana-legal: Noted. We'll coordinate local counsel. If committee approves band uplift + one-off gross-up, legal will require an indemnity clause and sign-off on tax counsel letter.

leo-finance: If approved, finance wants a cost center transfer plan if gross-up is later reversed. Need final number by EOD tomorrow to make payroll forecast.

marta-hm: Candidate wants confirmation within 72 hours. Can we commit to committee tomorrow + expedited legal review?

joel-comp: I'll push the item to the top of the agenda and ask comp-committee chair to call an emergency quorum if needed. Please ping me with the final packet link.

nina-peopleops: Packet link: `gdrive.com/asha-offer-packet` (contains comps, cashflow, immigration note, relocation tax memo).

sam-recruiter: Thanks all. I'll update the candidate to request 72-hr hold and will notify if anything changes. :pray:
